biography: Born in the quiet fjords of Norway, Charles Novak's path to racing was anything but typical. Unlike most drivers groomed from karting academies, Charles discovered his passion for speed on frozen lakes, modifying his father's old Volvo into a makeshift ice racer. His natural talent was undeniable; he could coax the aging machine to dance on the ice with a grace that belied his age. At 16, he sold his prized collection of Viking artifacts to fund a season in a local Formula Nordic series. He showed promise, but his inconsistency was glaring, alternating between podium finishes and spectacular crashes. Now at 19, Charles is an independent driver, scraping together sponsorship deals to compete in Formula Regional. His raw speed is undeniable, but harnessing his talent remains his biggest challenge. A recent high-profile shunt at the Hockenheimring, while battling for the lead, has only intensified the scrutiny on his inconsistent performances.
drivingStyle: Charles is an aggressive and opportunistic driver, known for his late-braking maneuvers and willingness to take risks. He thrives in chaotic conditions, often finding speed where others see danger. However, his aggressive style often leads to tire degradation and costly mistakes. He tends to overdrive the car, relying on instinct and raw talent rather than meticulous calculation. While his tire management needs work, his uncanny ability to sense grip in tricky conditions makes him a formidable opponent in wet races.

rivalries.reason: A fierce competitor from Italy. Their rivalry began after a controversial collision at Monza that cost Charles a potential victory. He accused her of deliberately blocking him.
A stoic and calculating Japanese driver. Kenji publicly criticized Charles' driving style as reckless, leading to heated exchanges in the media.
Another Norwegian driver, and a much more experienced racer. The older Volkov sees the younger Novak as a talentless showboat who is hurting Norway's reputation on the circuit.

quirks: Always wears a lucky troll doll inside his racing suit.
Listens to Norwegian death metal band 'Dimmu Borgir' before every race to 'channel the Viking spirit'.
Insists on eating a plate of Lefse (Norwegian flatbread) with lutefisk the night before a race.
famousQuote: "You can't tame the storm, you just have to learn to surf it. And sometimes, you wipe out. But you always get back up."
careerHighlight: Winning the Arctic Cup ice racing championship at the age of 15, beating drivers twice his age in a self-modified Volvo. This win convinced him that he could pursue a career in racing.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at Hockenheim, a wreck that destroyed a car and badly bruised his confidence after a promising weekend.
